bullets: Signup screen is nearly done, but a Safari password-focus bug is blocking the beta invite.
Pricing page refund wording is stuck waiting on legal; Dana now owns the follow-up.
Analytics dashboard is ~70% done; Postgres confirmed for launch, warehouse revisited afterwards.
Email-provider throttling could stop all fifty beta invites going out on launch day.
The investor demo date (the 20th) is unconfirmed and needs a check with the board.
summary.paragraph: The team reviewed launch readiness. Marcus will fix the Safari focus bug, Dana will send the refund wording to legal and draft a launch blog post, and Leo will investigate email sending limits. The team confirmed Postgres for the events table at launch. Open items include the investor demo date and an out-of-date README that nobody owns yet.

decisions.decision: Use Postgres for the events table at launch; revisit a hosted warehouse after launch.
decisions.rationale: Keeps launch scope small; the analytics dashboard is already built on it.
decisions.evidence_quote: Yes, Postgres for now. We can revisit the warehouse after launch.

decisions.decision: Dana owns the legal follow-up on the refund wording.
decisions.rationale: She already has the relationship with the legal team.
